<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Mantis Plate](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3198)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 100

**Price** 1,900 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 4
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Full Plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=50)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The beautiful plates of this _[+2](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2785) [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2786) [greater ready](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2792) [full plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=50)_ armor are shaped from the carapace of a deadly mantis, providing excellent protection with added flexibility. When wearing a suit of _mantis plate_, you gain a +1 item bonus to your [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) DC.

**Activate—Mandible Vambraces** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** Make a melee [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306). If you succeed, the target is caught by the spikes on the armor’s forearms, taking an additional 6d6 piercing damage (DC 30 basic Reflex save).

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the arms and carapace of a [deadly mantis](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3095).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
